description: This Java interface defines a builder pattern for creating responses to 'RetrieveThings' commands within the 'live' signals command framework. It includes nested interfaces for response creation, handling both success responses with optional filtering of fields.

classes.name: RetrieveThingsLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building command responses related to retrieving 'things' in a live query context.

classes.name: RetrieveThingsLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: A nested interface that provides methods to create success responses containing retrieved 'things', with optional filtering.

methods.name: retrieved
methods.description: Creates a success response with a list of 'Thing' objects and an optional predicate to filter fields included in the response.

methods.name: retrieved
methods.description: Creates a success response with a list of 'Thing' objects without any field filtering.
